rationale: dual_domain_bilateral_n2i-claude-agentic: warm_start=True, pretrain_epochs=1, pretrain_steps=20, n_iter=30, grad_clip=1.0, lr=0.005, proj_n_bf=2, img_n_bf=1, proj_kernel=5, proj_sx=1.0, proj_sy=2.0, proj_sr=0.02, img_kernel=7, img_sx=1.5, img_sy=1.5, img_sr=0.02, batch_size=1, train_n=200, val_n=214, outer_wall_s=1050, per_scene_s=None, seed=42, rationale=iter-5 (search-20260619-01, corrected 214-slice/321px-FOV metric). ONE KNOB: proj_n_bf 1 -> 2 (projection-domain trainable-bilateral DEPTH; params 6 -> 9 via 3*(proj_n_bf+img_n_bf)=3*(2+1)). BASED OFF iter-1 (the best-PSNR config: lr 5e-3, img_n_bf 1, proj_sr 0.02 -- the untouched warm-start-anchored baseline; img_n_bf and lr REVERTED to their iter-1 values so this is genuinely ONE knob vs iter-1). PER-IMAGE preserved (warm-start amortized pre-pass on 4 train patients -> generic BF-sigma init, then INDEPENDENT per-scan Adam fit on EACH L277 slice OWN half-angle measurements, GT-free; NEVER amortized). SIX-BOX (NUMBERS). (1) TRAJECTORY: iter-1 lr5e-3 proj_sr0.02 img_n_bf1 -> SSIM 0.92477 / PSNR 34.033 / RMSE 9.938e-4 / hr 0 / 940.4s (HIGHEST raw SSIM+PSNR of the run); iter-2 proj_sr0.02->0.0005 -> SSIM 0.92473 / PSNR 34.017 / hr 0 / 924.1s (proj_sr INERT, falsifier fired); iter-3 lr5e-3->3e-4 -> SSIM 0.92142 / PSNR 33.650 / hr 0 / 863.4s (lr DOWN made it WORSE, falsifier fired); iter-4 img_n_bf1->2 -> SSIM 0.89748 / PSNR 31.498 / RMSE 1.331e-3 / hr 0 / 972.6s (IMAGE-domain depth REGRESSED hard, falsifier fired). Best hr 0.0 throughout. (2) LIMITER = 6-param trainable-bilateral CAPACITY CEILING on dense-view 2304-view Mayo: highest raw SSIM of any Mayo inference solver yet PSNR sits BELOW the LD-FBP floor -> hr 0. Three confirmed-dead levers (proj_sr inert, per-scan lr-down regressed, image-domain img_n_bf-up regressed). The sibling U-Net dual_domain_n2i CLEARED the floor (iter-4 hr 0.198) because it has a REAL denoiser; the few-param bilateral cannot. (3) ONE KNOB = proj_n_bf 1->2: image-domain depth (iter-4) regressed and image-domain sigma is inert (iter-2), so the remaining untested per-image axis is the PROJECTION domain -- which iter-2 established is Mayo bilateral lever-SIDE (proj, not image). proj_n_bf adds DOF on the lever-side rather than the regressing image-side. Modest +1 step (matches the supervised-sibling instability caution at big jumps). (4) HYPOTHESIS: adding ONE projection-domain bilateral layer denoises the dense 2304-view sinogram BEFORE backprojection without the image-domain over-smoothing that regressed iter-4 -> RMSE drops -> PSNR clears the LD-FBP floor -> hr rises above 0 (predict hr ~0.0-0.05, edging toward the U-Net sibling). FALSIFIER (NUMBERS): if hr stays 0 (PSNR <= iter-1 34.03 with no RMSE drop) at proj_n_bf=2, then proj-domain depth is ALSO exhausted and the trainable-bilateral N2I is STRUCTURALLY CAPPED on dense-view Mayo regardless of which domain gets capacity -- every per-image knob (proj_sr, lr, img_n_bf, proj_n_bf) retired, structural-ceiling verdict filed: only the U-Net N2I real-denoiser capacity clears the FBP floor here (half-view N2I info loss < full-view LD-FBP). (5) BUDGET (HARD 20-min = 1200s): proj_n_bf 1->2 adds ONE proj-domain BF fwd+bwd per Adam step; dominant cost is the 2304-view FBP adjoint (FLAT in proj_n_bf). iter-1 base 940.4s; +1 proj-BF layer adds <~10% -> expect ~1000s = ~16.7 min, inside 1200s with ~200s slack. n_iter=30, val=ALL 214, grad_clip=1.0 MANDATORY, lr/img_n_bf reverted to iter-1. in-solver outer_wall_s=1050 (17.5 min) backstop guarantees a recorded result. (6) HARD 20-min budget; val=ALL 214 L277 slices (NOT reduced); PER-IMAGE preserved (warm_start True, grad_clip 1.0, img_sr 0.02 NOT tightened). Do NOT return control mid-campaign. PREDICTED iter-5: hr ~0.0-0.05 if proj-domain capacity helps; hr<=0 falsifies (bilateral structurally capped on Mayo regardless of domain, only U-Net N2I works).
